curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8862-1/ (scans, two pages per image; the backhoe is pages 4-30, the alternate model after)

functions.does: The round yellow knob on the cab roof steers the front wheels: its shaft runs down through the cab to a bevel pair, and a shaft with a universal joint runs forward to an 8-tooth gear on the steering rack.

The handwheel low on the right, in front of the cab, raises and lowers the loader arms: a bevel pair and a worm turn a crown gear on a cross-shaft, whose cranks push the arms up through short links. The bucket stays roughly level.

The handwheel low on the left, in front of the cab, tips the loader bucket: a bevel pair and a worm turn a crown gear on a second cross-shaft, whose cranks work rods along the arms to a three-armed rocker on each arm and on to the bucket.

The handwheel high in the cab on the right swings both outriggers out and down together: its shaft runs down to a bevel pair and a worm, which turns a crown gear driving two 16-tooth gears, each turning an 8-tooth gear on the 24-tooth gear on one outrigger's arms.
Each outrigger's foot tilts on toothed toggle joints to sit flat on the ground.
functions.source: book: step 24 (insets 1-5); inferred: the book doesn't show it tilting

functions.does: The handwheel high in the cab on the left slews the backhoe: its shaft runs down to a bevel pair and a worm under the turntable, which turns the crown gear on the turntable's post.
The cylinder on the turntable raises and lowers the backhoe's boom.
functions.note: In the set the pump and a valve work the cylinder; dragging the boom stands in for them until air is modelled.

functions.does: The cylinder along the top of the boom swings the dipper arm in and out.
functions.note: In the set the pump and a valve work the cylinder; dragging the dipper stands in for them until air is modelled.

functions.does: The cylinder on the dipper arm curls and opens the backhoe bucket through a short linkage.
functions.note: In the set the pump and a valve work the cylinder; dragging the bucket stands in for them until air is modelled.

functions.does: Pumping the pump, whose knob stands up through the bonnet, with one of the three valves at the back of the cab's left side pushed one way or the other, works that valve's cylinder.
functions.source: book: steps 14, 20-21 and 25; inferred: which valve works which cylinder

functions.does: The bonnet over the pump lifts on the axle along its back edge.
functions.source: inferred: book step 21 builds the bonnet on an axle along its back edge

functions.does: The four wheels roll freely; nothing drives them.

questions.question: Which valve works which cylinder? Does the bonnet lift? Do the outrigger feet tilt? Is the loader arm's brace pinned at both ends?
